# Architecture decision records

<!-- Generated by make gen. Do not edit. -->

Each record states one decision and the reason for it. Template decisions (`TPL-NNNN`, under `template/`) come with the template, and a team that copies the template never edits them. Project decisions (`ADR-NNNN`) are the decisions of that team, and a project decision replaces a template decision by naming it in `supersedes`. [TPL-0001](template/TPL-0001-record-decisions-as-adrs.md) defines the format.

None yet.
